personality_one_liner: A tranquil, organic, and restorative space that blends the elegance of a garden makeover with the approachable warmth of a personal journal.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable, and slightly irregular layouts. Whitespace should feel calm and restorative. Use padding intentionally to create a scrap-book or journal-like layered rhythm.

do's: Use heavy tint + blur for the shoppable product hotspots (+ markers) floating over AI images to guarantee they stand out against complex garden scenes.
Use for the persistent floating AI Garden Assistant chatbot button.
Use on sticky headers if content scrolls behind them.
dont's: Do not use glass on body content cards or directory listings, which should feel paper-like and tactile.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A welcoming dashboard combining quick actions, community polls, and personalized project tracking.

states.loading: Soft pulsing skeleton shapes representing organic card layouts.
states.empty: Tranquil garden illustration with a gentle prompt to start a new project.
states.error: Calm error message with a 'Try Again' button, ensuring the user doesn't feel stressed.

screens.layout: Top bar features a subtle visit counter and grouped social icons (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube). Immediately below is a large, immersive hero card with a tranquil water/sky background, gradient scrim, and a primary 'Start Project' CTA. Weekly poll appears as a soft, layered modal popup overlay upon first load. Below the hero, horizontal scrolling list of 'My Projects'. Persistent floating chatbot button at the bottom right corner (safe area cleared).

screens.name: CreateProject
screens.purpose: A calming, guided flow to upload or capture a photo of the user's current garden.

states.loading: Full-screen camera initialization view or photo uploading spinner.
states.error: Error toast indicating camera permission denied or upload failure.

screens.layout: Focus heavily on the camera viewfinder or photo picker gallery. Use soft, semi-transparent overlays for the camera controls. A primary CTA 'Redesign with AI' pinned to the bottom. Keep the interface minimal to let the user focus on the photo framing.

screens.name: ProjectRedesignViewer
screens.purpose: The core 'magic' screen displaying the AI-generated garden transformation with shoppable affiliate hotspots.

states.loading: Lottie animation of growing plants/flowers or a soft botanical progress indicator.
states.error: Retry button overlaid on the original uploaded image.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge image view of the garden. A smooth interactive Before/After toggle/slider at the bottom above the safe area. Overlaid on the 'After' image are scattered shoppable product hotspots (+ icons in glassmorphism circles). Tapping a hotspot opens a '@gorhom/bottom-sheet' revealing the product image, description, and link to the retailer. Top header contains a 'Save' and 'Share' (QR code) icon.

screens.name: CommunityWall
screens.purpose: A serene, Pinterest-style feed for users to share and browse garden ideas.

states.loading: Staggered skeleton blocks imitating masonry cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a solitary bench under a tree with a prompt to 'Be the first to share an idea'.
states.error: Standard text prompt to reload the feed.

screens.layout: A 2-column masonry grid (or staggered 1-column if simpler) of user-shared garden redesigns. Cards have irregular radii (mix of md and lg) to feel organic and scrapbook-like. Each card shows the user's avatar, a short caption, and the main image. A sticky 'Share to Wall' FAB at the bottom center.

screens.name: Contractors
screens.purpose: A directory to find, review, and track professional landscapers and gardeners.

states.empty: Illustration of gardening tools and text indicating no contractors found in the area.

screens.layout: List-based directory. Each contractor card features their profile photo, a prominent TripAdvisor-style star rating (using brandTertiary for stars), and contact buttons (Phone, Message). Inside a contractor's detail view, display the 'completion tracker for jobs' as a soft, organic progress bar, along with generated contracts and a review feed.

home_hero_bg.alt: A serene garden fountain surrounded by lush greenery and statues, under a clear blue sky

project_before_demo.alt: Abandoned rustic house with overgrown garden and scattered trash outdoors

project_after_demo.alt: A beautiful sunny landscaped backyard patio with a table, chairs, and bench

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette mapped in this file. The blue (brandSecondary) was explicitly approved in the problem statement for sky/water elements, so it overrides the standard blue ban.

Implement the shoppable hotspots on the Redesign screen using absolute positioning over the image. These hotspots MUST use glassmorphism (expo-blur) with a heavy tint underneath to guarantee the '+' icon is readable against busy garden photos.
Every image used as a background (e.g., home_hero_bg) MUST have a linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) layered over it before rendering text on top to ensure WCAG AA contrast.
The AI chatbot is a persistent floating action button (FAB) that stays accessible across primary screens. Ensure it sits safely above the bottom tab bar and respects the safe area.
Use the 'Fraunces' font for display/headings to inject the 'Glam up' aesthetic, while utilizing 'Nunito' for body text to maintain the approachable, organic feel.
